verdict.rationale: Docs show admin-relevant features: inviting team members, SSO integration, sharing conversations only with active-license members, and enterprise-grade privacy protections in team workspaces, indicating some org management and trust controls exist. However, evidence lacks detail on granular permissions/roles, data retention/policy configuration, or audit logging beyond these surface mentions. Missing for 10: granular role/permission management, data governance/retention policy controls, audit logs, and independent/hands-on verification of admin console usability.
